messages.subject: googleVis on shiny is not working with korean character(maybe all multibyte char.)
parts:
i just used renderGvis() function for testing.

#ui.R

shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
  headerPanel("Example 4: pageable table"),
  sidebarPanel(
    checkboxInput(inputId = "pageable", label = "Pageable"),
    conditionalPanel("input.pageable==true",
                     numericInput(inputId = "pagesize",
                                  label = "Countries per page",10))    
  ),
  mainPanel(
    htmlOutput("myTable")
  )
))


#server.R

## Diego de Castillo, February 2013
library(datasets)
library(googleVis)
library(shiny)

shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  myOptions <- reactive({
    list(
      page=ifelse(input$pageable==TRUE,'enable','disable'),
      pageSize=input$pagesize,
      width=550
    )
  })
  output$myTable <- renderGvis({
alldata <- read.csv("c:\\coding\\shiny\\Cs101110.txt")
gvisTable(alldata,options=myOptions())         
  })
})



this is working when my csv file have only english character.
but just add korean character in my csv file, this is not working.

what should i do?

just use googlsVis in R, good working.
and just use Shiny in R, good working too.

but combining of two. not working.

thanks.
